product.name: Workstream by Monoprice Easy Height-Adjustable Free Standing Single Monitor Desk Mount for Monitors Up To 27in
product.description: This free standing monitor mount features easy vertical height adjustment for computer displays. Instantly raise your monitor to add extra height, handy for changing positions throughout the day to stay comfortable. It is extra useful for use with sit‑stand desks for quick monitor adjustments when you change desk height settings. Just lift your monitor upwards and the ratcheting mechanism automatically locks the height setting. No cumbersome screws or locks need to be set. To lower the monitor, raise it all the way up to unlock the ratchet to allow it to be lowered all the way down.Aside from easy height adjustment, it is also easy to move the monitor on your desk, thanks to the free standing base. No clamping or drilling is needed. The base is a solid steel platform, that ensures stability while providing flexibility.Features: Easy height adjustmentPlace your monitor anywhere on your deskNo need to clamp or drill holesWorks with any desk and computer setupWorks great with sit‑stand desksWorks with most monitors up to 27" and weighing up to 13.2 lbs.*Supports 75x75 and 100x100 VESA® patternsThe solid, powder‑coated steel base provides stabilityQuality metal structural parts ensure durabilityFeatures quick release VESA plate*The minimum and maximum display sizes are only approximations. Your TV will work with this mount as long as it has a compatible VESA® pattern and maximum weight. Support Files: User's Manual (Oct 30, 2018)Monoprice™, WORKSTREAM™, the WORKSTREAM logo, and all Monoprice logos are trademarks of Monoprice Inc.
